tags.label: Fourier epicycles
tags.description: A closed curve as a chain of turning circles: the discrete Fourier transform of the sampled curve, terms sorted by size. Figures are hand-built parametric curves and polygons (heart, trefoil, Fay's butterfly, hypotrochoid, lemniscate, rose). Written for the Atelier residency, 2026-10-06.
